components: One moving packet and stationary site stocks exchange excess with local stock: a site receiving k>=1 sends 1+s units forward and leaves k-1. With two indistinguishable units the marked detector can be implemented by splitting and rejoining matter. All physical states in the selected example are compared, including traps.
candidates.declared_status: A simpler material realization in a prepared architecture, not a derivation of motion, time, charge, independent outcomes or physical absorption.
missing_bridges: Establish addressing, port routing, graph installation and which observable counts packets rather than total flux. A greater load can distinguish rules invisible to threshold readings.

components: A shared ring of equal-baseline taps stores the source of a pending report as a local excess defect and restores it on return. Two baseline levels and a reversible cold meter provide one unit crossing at the observer per serial occupied signal hop, without a source address or synchronized sampling clock.
candidates.declared_status: Serial common-observer count with explicit apparatus and restoration; overlapping requests can undercount and a destructive read breaks the path.
missing_bridges: Explain the extra baseline units and port network, serial preparation and physical non-destructive record. One source stimulus need not constitute one counted hop.

components: Three local swap cells, one controllable bypass and a fixed sixteen-passage word transform each prepared two-of-four packet into the complement of a repeatable four-cycle of its occupied slots. The same local hub can later identify the result without opening the remote stores.
candidates.declared_status: Finite population transformation synthesized for an explicit target; centered fixed-total contrasts undergo a signed permutation, not arbitrary amplitude mixing.
missing_bridges: Generate the switched schedule, reusable preparations and physical composability, and distinguish registered packet marginals from independent Born readout.

components: Of 720 bijections on six two-of-four packets only 24 wire permutations and 24 complemented permutations preserve equal first-moment distributions on every input ensemble. A witnessed pair of ensembles exposes each other map. More slots with exactly two marks allow only wire permutations under the same closure demand.
candidates.declared_status: Finite census and conditional combinatorial obstruction; not a prohibition on operations using correlations, ancillas, other occupancy sectors or amplitudes.
missing_bridges: Specify whether the physical observer has access to coincidences rather than just individual port counts and how it composes or regroups packets.

components: All 64000 ordered three-cell assemblies with static conserving reciprocal laws are tested on all six two-mark inputs. No common hub-return count gives the programmed complement-plus-four-cycle target. Sixteen devices do realize bare complement; a symmetric X-S-X assembly does so at the third return in 32 physical edge hops for every prepared input.
candidates.declared_status: Exact census of fixed wiring and common-count gates, with secondary pure complement explicitly distinguished from the primary missed target.
missing_bridges: Derive the preparation, completion marker, output ownership, and access to other sectors rather than relabeling the zero-hit target as a success.

components: Exact congruences for actual hub return times test whether different numbers of passages on the six inputs can reach one common elapsed-time complement-plus-four-cycle gate. No such time exists in the frozen static family. Two local states cannot recognize the third X-S-X return from side and lane alone, while a three-state event counter can.
candidates.declared_status: Clock contract on equal-duration edges and a finite local observation alphabet; not a universal exclusion of self-timed hardware or other completion interfaces.
missing_bridges: Realize a suitable internal physical marker, compare alternative signal velocities and retain distinct ports rather than postselecting elapsed times after inspecting one input.
